name: @flippo-software/eslint
description:
ESLint configuration for Flippo. 
 Separately, you need to install 'eslint'. For configuration with the reagent, you must additionally install 'eslint-plugin-react-hooks', 'eslint-plugin-react-refresh', '@eslint-react/eslint-plugin'. If necessary, 'eslint-plugin-turbo' can be installed for 'Turborepo'.

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: test "$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD)" != main || { echo '✖ Direct commits to main are not allowed — create a feature branch.' >&2; exit 1; }
simple-git-hooks.pre-push: while read local_ref local_sha remote_ref remote_sha; do case "$remote_ref" in refs/heads/main) echo '✖ Direct pushes to main are not allowed — open a pull request.' >&2; exit 1;; esac; done
